title: Natural derived DVR tower comparison on K-flat resolutions
statement: Fix l, E, an adic datum d, a scheme T and its coefficient model C of [def-sf-open-quotient-koszul-models], a coefficient calculus S of [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus], and an ordinary quotient tensor model M of [def-trf-completion-unit-models]. Given an ordinary natural tensor-tower comparison nu from completed-adic tensor after C.modules to M.tensor after exact scalar restriction and C.ordinaryTowers, and any natural comparison epsilon from Q followed by S.reduction to M.quotient followed by Q which is invertible on flat-term K-flat complexes, there exists a natural isomorphism t between completed-adic reduction after C.derived and S.reduction after exact restriction and C.towers. On every flat-term K-flat Q it identifies the completed-adic reduction counit followed by Q(nu_Q) with t_Q followed by C.towers applied to epsilon_Q and the exact restriction localization factor, followed by the exact coefficient-tower localization factor. This constructs no augmentation and proves no total-limit unit formula.

proof.text: Flat-term K-flat resolutions exist. The canonical coefficient ring isomorphism preserves independent-coefficient K-flatness by ringIso_tensor_transport; translate to the acyclic tensor K-flat API. Hence the completed-adic counit is an isomorphism on these complexes by Koszul reconstruction. The tensor presentation isomorphism converts exactness of tensorRight into the site-sheaf flatness convention.

Use the exact restriction and coefficient localization factors to make epsilon, followed by nu inverse, a natural transformation to the same localized ordinary tower functor as the completed-adic counit. It is invertible on the resolving class by the hypothesis on epsilon. Apply comparison_from_resolutions to the two natural transformations. Its representative equality gives the counit square after cancelling Q(nu inverse); functoriality combines the two restricted maps.

theorem openDvrDerivedTowerComparison
    (d : AdicCoefficientDatum (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E))
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (C : OpenDvrCoefficientModel l E d T)
    (S : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus.{u, u} l E T)
    (M : CompletionUnit.OrdinaryModel l E T)
    (ν : C.modules.functor ⋙ completedAdicOrdinaryTower T d ≅
      M.tensor ⋙ coefficientSequenceRestriction.{u, u} l E T ⋙ C.ordinaryTowers)
    (ε : DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ S.reduction ⟶ M.quotient l E T ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)
    (hε : ∀ Q : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E T) ℤ,
      CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
        (J := ProEt.topology T)
        (R := completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted.{u, u} l E T) Q →
      (∀ i : ℤ, SheafOfModules.IsFlatOnSite.{u + 1, u, u + 1, u + 1}
        (J := ProEt.topology T)
        (R := completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted.{u, u} l E T) (Q.X i)) →
      IsIso (ε.app Q)) :
    ∃ t : C.derived.functor ⋙ completedAdicReduction T d ≅
        S.reduction ⋙ coefficientSequenceDerivedRestriction.{u, u} l E T ⋙ C.towers,
      ∀ (Q : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E T) ℤ)
        (_hQ : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
          (J := ProEt.topology T)
          (R := completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted.{u, u} l E T) Q)
        (_hflat : ∀ i : ℤ, SheafOfModules.IsFlatOnSite.{u + 1, u, u + 1, u + 1}
          (J := ProEt.topology T)
          (R := completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted.{u, u} l E T) (Q.X i)),
      let I := (M.quotient l E T).obj Q
      let B := (CompletionUnit.tower l E T).obj I
      (completedAdicReduction T d).map
          (C.modules.functor.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app Q) ≫
        reconstructionReductionComplexCounit T d (C.complexes.obj Q) ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex ν (.up ℤ)).hom.app Q) =
      t.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q) ≫
        C.towers.map ((coefficientSequenceDerivedRestriction.{u, u} l E T).map
          (ε.app Q) ≫
            (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.{u+2, u+2, u+1, u+1, u+2, u+2}
              (coefficientSequenceRestriction.{u, u} l E T)).hom.app I) ≫
        C.ordinaryTowers.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app B
